name: Improved RAHT-based Compression of 3D Gaussian Splats
definition: A compression scheme for 3D Gaussian Splats that interprets 3DGS as a point cloud with rich attributes, using RAHT for transform coding, fine-tuning to promote sparsity in the transform domain, and channel-wise bit allocation based on rendering impact.
summary: This method compresses 3D Gaussian Splatting models by applying RAHT transform coding to all Gaussian attributes, distinguishing itself by operating on untrained models without pipeline changes.
